description: An extra-axial solid mass lesion measuring about 30*35*45 mm with dural tail along the left frontotemporal lobes. The mass lesion is somewhat isointense to gray matter both on T1WI and T2WI with marked homogeneous enhancement on post-contrast images. No edema in the underlying brain parenchyma.
